matches.rationale: The ground truth concerns a logical inconsistency between the Merging Discriminator's patch-merging process and the Frustum Culling removal criterion (unclear tracking of patches across views). Finding 1 instead claims a mathematical inversion in a specific depth-threshold inequality (z_c vs d_{u,v}+delta) that is not mentioned anywhere in the quoted text_in_paper, representing a different, apparently fabricated issue. Finding 2 addresses an unrelated contrastive loss equation (Eqs. 5-7) in a different part of Section 3.1, with no connection to the merging/culling contradiction described in the ground truth.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Describes an equation and inequality not present in the quoted text and misidentifies the actual method-logic contradiction described in the ground truth.
Targets a different equation set (contrastive loss) unrelated to the Merging Discriminator/Frustum Culling contradiction described in the ground truth.
